mentalModelCheck.question: What is the role of <= in Erlang expressions like << <<B:8>> || <<B:8>> <= Bin >>?

options.label: It is the binary generator operator in binary comprehensions, streaming bit patterns out of Bin
options.explanation: <= extracts binary segments in comprehensions, whereas =< is the numeric less-than-or-equal comparison operator.
